gitCommit.subject: refactor+feat: 統一 AI Tool 參數欄位結構並新增 select 欄位支援 (#1387)
gitCommit.body:
refactor+feat: 統一 AI Tool 參數欄位結構並新增 select 欄位支援 (#1387)

* refactor+feat: 統一 AI Tool 參數欄位結構並新增 select 欄位支援

refactor: 整合 AI Tool 參數欄位並追加下拉選單支援
1. 整合 Gemini / ComfyUI 參數欄位為統一模型（UiParameterField）
2. 追加 select 欄位型別支援，包含欄位解析、預設值與表單渲染

refactor: unify AI Tool parameter fields and add select dropdown support

1. Unified Gemini / ComfyUI parameter fields into a single model (UiParameterField)
2. Added select field type support, including field parsing, default values, and form rendering

^ Conflicts:
^	app/[locale]/(main)/ai-tools/[slug]/_components/ai-tool-detail-client.tsx
^	constants/ai-tool.ts

* refactor: enhance placeholder logic in AI tool input fields

- Updated the placeholder logic in NumberField and VideoField components to prioritize field descriptions, improving user guidance.
- Simplified the placeholder in TextField to a default input prompt for consistency.
- Added default input placeholder translations for English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese, enhancing localization support.

* refactor: remove toast notifications for like/unlike actions in AI tool components

- Eliminated toast notifications for successful like/unlike actions in both AiToolDetailClient and AiToolsClient components to streamline user feedback.
- Updated AiToolCarousel to accept sessionUser as a prop, enhancing user interaction by managing like state based on authentication.
- Improved API route to return user-specific like states, ensuring accurate display of liked tools for authenticated users.

* refactor: enhance description rendering in AI tool fields

- Updated description rendering in various AI tool components (AiToolDetailClient, ImageField, NumberField, TextField, VideoField) to support whitespace preservation using the `whitespace-pre-wrap` class.
- Improved layout consistency and user experience by ensuring descriptions are displayed correctly across different field types.
- Minor adjustments to the AI tool form layout for better responsiveness and clarity.

* fix: update field description text to support line breaks in localization files

- Modified the `fieldDescriptionText` in English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese localization files to indicate support for line breaks, enhancing user guidance and clarity in form fields.

* feat: add boolean field support in AI tool forms

- Enhanced the `FormPreviewAndTest` and `AiToolDetailPage` components to handle boolean field types, ensuring default values are set correctly.
- Updated the `ComfyUIParameterSchemaBuilder` to include boolean field handling, including option labels and default values.
- Introduced a switch component in the `AiToolUserForm` for boolean fields, improving user interaction and clarity.
- Modified localization files to include new boolean field descriptions and options, enhancing user guidance across multiple languages.

* feat: enhance ComfyUIParameterSchemaBuilder with option label toggling

- Added functionality to toggle the visibility of option labels in the ComfyUIParameterSchemaBuilder, improving user interaction and clarity.
- Introduced new icons for expand/collapse actions, enhancing the UI experience.
- Updated localization files to remove deprecated question type entries, streamlining the parameter schema options.
- Refactored related components for improved readability and maintainability.

* feat: enhance AI tool forms with preview link and boolean field improvements

- Added a preview link in the `AiToolForm` for editing tools, allowing users to view changes on the site directly.
- Updated the `ComfyUIParameterSchemaBuilder` and `GeminiParameterSchemaBuilder` to support boolean fields with switch components, improving user interaction.
- Introduced collapsible sections for parameter previews in both builders, enhancing the UI experience.
- Enhanced localization files to include new strings for the preview link and boolean field descriptions, ensuring clarity across multiple languages.
- Refactored parameter field utilities to accommodate new boolean field types and improve maintainability.

* feat: enhance AI tool forms with new parameter schema components and tooltip support

- Introduced `ParameterSchemaFieldCard` and `ParameterSchemaFieldSections` components to improve the structure and rendering of parameter fields in the AI tool forms.
- Added `TooltipIcon` to provide contextual help for field labels, enhancing user experience and clarity.
- Refactored `ComfyUIParameterMappingBuilder` and `AiToolFormBasicInfoSection` to utilize the new tooltip functionality, improving the overall UI consistency.
- Updated localization files to include new strings for tooltips and field descriptions, ensuring comprehensive user guidance across multiple languages.
- Implemented utility functions for managing parameter fields, enhancing maintainability and readability of the codebase.

* feat: implement drag-and-drop functionality for parameter fields in ComfyUIParameterSchemaBuilder

- Introduced `SortableFieldCard` component to enable drag-and-drop reordering of parameter fields, enhancing user interaction and flexibility.
- Integrated DnD context and sensors for improved drag-and-drop experience.
- Updated `useParameterSchemaFields` hook to support field reordering logic.
- Enhanced localization files to include new confirmation messages for option deletions, ensuring clarity across multiple languages.
- Refactored related components for better maintainability and readability.

* feat: implement drag-and-drop reordering for options in ParameterSchemaSelectSection

- Added drag-and-drop functionality using DnD Kit to reorder options within the ParameterSchemaSelectSection, enhancing user experience and flexibility.
- Introduced SortableOptionCard component for rendering sortable options with visual feedback during dragging.
- Updated state management to handle option reordering and maintain data integrity.
- Refactored related components for improved maintainability and readability.

* feat: enhance AI tool fields with multilingual display names and descriptions

- Implemented `getFieldDisplayName` and `getFieldDisplayDescription` utility functions to support multilingual field labels and descriptions across various AI tool components.
- Updated `ImageField`, `NumberField`, `TextField`, `VideoField`, and `AiToolUserForm` to utilize the new display functions, improving user experience and clarity.
- Enhanced localization files to include new strings for field display names and descriptions, ensuring comprehensive support for multiple languages.
- Refactored related components for improved maintainability and readability.

* feat: refactor parameter schema components for improved maintainability and performance

- Extracted `SortableOptionCard` component to enhance the modularity and stability of option rendering in `ParameterSchemaSelectSection`.
- Updated `useParameterSchemaFields` hook to utilize `useCallback` for optimized performance in field management functions.
- Improved error handling and state management in `GeminiParameterSchemaBuilder` by refining schema parsing logic.
- Refactored related components to ensure consistent design and responsiveness across the AI tool forms.
- Enhanced localization support by ensuring all new components and features are properly integrated with translation functions.

---------

Co-authored-by: endman100 <endman246738@gmail.com>
Co-authored-by: 13 <katie87827@gmail.com>
